params.message: shoulders a drum onto the hand-truck with a practised grunt.

chitchat: "Cash job, no names. Same as everybody in here."
"Careful with the jugs, friend. That one bites."
description: A day-laborer leaning on a hand-truck stacked with drums, waiting on a delivery run and the wages that come with it. The name stencilled down the side of his hand-truck is T. OKORO, and he would like it back if it walks off again.

root.text: He tips his chin at you. "Angus is at the counter. Watch the forklift." He shifts his grip on the hand-truck. "Tam. In case the forklift gets me and somebody has to fill in a form."

name: Tam Okoro
